        u, v = v, u
    diff = depth[v] - depth[u]
    for i in range(18, -1, -1):
        if diff & (1 << i):

            if parent[u][i] != parent[v][i]:
                u = parent[u][i]
                v = parent[v][i]
        u = parent[u][0]
    return u
